> DSFR AI Components — Plain-text agent protocol
> Tuiles auto-contenues du Système de Design de l'État. Markup et métadonnées are original works; fr-* class names used under DSFR terms.
> Home: https://github.com/ednark/dsfr-ai-components
> Base layer: https://github.com/ednark/ai-component-registry-spec (submodule at _base/)

---

## Overview

Registre de composants DSFR pour agents de programmation IA construisant des services de l'État français. 38 tuiles auto-contenues across 26 component families with categorized adaptation, coordination, and compliance metadata (RGAA 4.1, WCAG 2.1 AA, Directive (UE) 2016/2102).

## Machine manifest

> https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ednark/dsfr-ai-components/main/agents.json

---

## Quick start

1. Filter vocab: GET https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ednark/dsfr-ai-components/main/infinite/facets.json
2. Discovery index (lean): GET https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ednark/dsfr-ai-components/main/infinite/components.index.json
3. Component source: GET https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ednark/dsfr-ai-components/main/infinite/{file}
4. Recipes: GET https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ednark/dsfr-ai-components/main/infinite/recipes/index.json
   (formulaire-contact, confirmation-page, search-results, multi-step-form, content-page)
5. Version history: GET https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ednark/dsfr-ai-components/main/infinite/versions.json

---

## Facets

- dsfrComponentType — button, input, select, checkbox, radio, alert, table, card, etc.
- section — forms, navigation, feedback, data-display
- variant — component variant
- requiresJs — no, optional, required
- interaction — passive, click, focus, keyboard, type, change
- govCompliance — RGAA 4.1, WCAG 2.1 AA, Directive (UE) 2016/2102
- a11y — wcag21AA, keyboardNav, screenReader, reducedMotion, forcedColors, ariaAttributes
- costTier — cheap, moderate, expensive
- compositionRecipes — recipes this component participates in
- piiHandling — accepts_input, displays_only, none
- touchTargetSize — 44px on interactive components
- supportedTokenProfiles — highContrast, darkMode (official DSFR themes)

---

## DSFR rules

- Erreurs par champ : fr-error-text + fr-*-group--error — pas de résumé d'erreurs global
- Chaque contrôle inclut son groupe (fr-input-group, fr-select-group, fr-fieldset) — pas de prerequisite externe
- Thèmes clair/sombre officiels via data-fr-theme
- RGAA 4.1 pour l'accessibilité

---

## Output contract

1. Reason — why this component over alternatives
2. Selected components — file paths and titles
3. DSFR classes needed — exact fr-* class names
4. Constraint verification — preserve elements intact
5. Remaining work — what the component does not cover
6. Recommended next — what to retrieve next
